sql:
SELECT 
    ((MAX(CASE WHEN T1.position = 1 THEN T1.milliseconds ELSE NULL END) + MIN(CASE WHEN T1.position > 1 THEN T1.milliseconds ELSE NULL END)) - MAX(CASE WHEN T1.position = 1 THEN T1.milliseconds ELSE NULL END)) / MIN(CASE WHEN T1.position > 1 THEN T1.milliseconds ELSE NULL END) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM results AS T1
JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid
WHERE T2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND T2.year = 2008
AND T1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
